name: Whop
summary: Whop is an internet commerce platform that lets individuals and businesses create storefronts, accept payments, and sell digital products, memberships, and services.
overview: Whop provides commerce infrastructure for internet businesses. Its platform combines storefronts, payments, communities, and tools for selling digital products and services.

facts.label: Reported valuation
facts.note: Whop said Tether made a $200 million strategic investment at a $1.6 billion valuation.

facts.label: Public status
facts.note: No confirmed public offering is reflected in this profile.

bull_case: A unified product for payments, storefronts, and communities can reduce the friction of starting an internet business and compound through creator and merchant distribution.
bear_case: Whop operates in a crowded commerce stack, and creator-economy demand can shift quickly between platforms and formats.
directory_notes: Watch for merchant volume and monetization disclosures.

intelligence.description: Whop is a commerce platform for creating, operating, and selling internet businesses.
company: Whop provides a platform for individuals and businesses to create storefronts, collect payments, run communities, and sell products or services online. The company positions the product as an operating layer for internet businesses rather than a single-purpose marketplace.
In December 2025, Whop announced a $200 million strategic investment from Tether at a $1.6 billion valuation. Whop says more than $4.6 billion has been paid to businesses through its platform.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Whop sits where payments, digital commerce, and creator tools overlap. Its ability to aggregate merchant activity makes it a relevant private-market signal for the economics of online entrepreneurship and payments infrastructure.

changed.text: Tether made a $200 million strategic investment valuing Whop at $1.6 billion.

takeaways: Whop combines commerce, payments, and community tooling in one platform.
The company announced a $200 million strategic investment from Tether in December 2025.
That investment placed its reported valuation at $1.6 billion.
Merchant payment volume and retention are the central execution questions.
